Putting `#label` into the search box feels right because it makes the filter visible, easy to clear, and available to combine with other terms.

If the search box is empty, clicking a label should simply set that label filter. If I already have a search in progress, I’d prefer the label to be added so it narrows the current results rather than discarding my search. That combination should behave as “the existing search and this label.”
